suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO Event Loop: How Single-Threaded Concurrency Works
suggestion.rationale: Developers struggle to understand how Python achieves high throughput on a single CPU core without traditional multithreading. Addressing this directly feeds massive search volume for asyncio fundamentals.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using time.sleep() in your APIs. Here is how Python's single-threaded event loop actually juggles 10,000 concurrent requests without breaking a sweat.
